tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background. Light: the concrete wall (with grain, see bs-wall). Dark: the stage, used for pack review and the bandmate view only.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fill of cards, rows, choice tiles and never-tiles sitting on surface. Always paired with a 2px line border.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and modal panels.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text inputs, so typing reads as paper on the wall.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: The desk around the phone frame on wide screens; never inside the app.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and sheets.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and 2px borders. 12.2:1 on surface (wall), 14.2:1 on surface-raised (stage).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: eyebrows, mono notes, row meta. 5.1:1 on wall, 7.9:1 on stage. Adjusted from the prototype's #5B5F66, which is only 4.1:1 on the wall.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 2px borders of cards, inputs, chips and the bottom nav. Borders, not shadows, separate things.

tokens.name: line-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed dividers between list rows and the countdown line. Decorative only.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Yellow gaffer tape: the ONE app accent. Selected state, the next step, highlight labels, the hazard strip. Never as text on wall (1.05:1).

tokens.name: on-tape
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tape. 12.8:1.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Inverts on stage.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action button.

tokens.name: veto
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'nope' / changes-needed status. Text on it is on-veto.

tokens.name: on-veto
tokens.usage: Label on veto. 6.3:1.

tokens.name: veto-ink
tokens.usage: Veto as text or a stamp outline (the NOPE stamp). 5.1:1 on wall, 6.1:1 on stage. The prototype's #B8261C on wall is 4.1:1, too low for small text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px with 2px offset. The prototype used tape on wall, which is invisible (1.05:1), so light uses ink.

tokens.name: poster-paper
tokens.usage: SAMPLE ONLY: placeholder band artwork in prototypes. The app owns no colour; real posters bring the band's own.

tokens.name: poster-black
tokens.usage: SAMPLE ONLY: placeholder poster ground.

tokens.name: poster-red
tokens.usage: SAMPLE ONLY: placeholder poster hot colour.

tokens.name: poster-blue
tokens.usage: SAMPLE ONLY: placeholder poster hot colour, second band.

styles.name: headline-xl
styles.usage: Screen headline, one per screen. Width axis 125% (font-stretch:125%). Scales clamp(26px,8vw,34px). text-wrap:balance.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Step numbers and dates as shapes. Width axis 62% (condensed).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Row and option titles, poster deck labels. Width 108%.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick the one that looks more like you.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Tour-diary detail: captions, meta, the schedule, status bar.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrow, letter-spacing .06em. Text-transform uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: meter ticks, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, buttons in a dock, rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between choice tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a screen body.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (or the safe-area inset, whichever is bigger).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large vertical break, e.g. the making screen.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Paper things are square: tape, cards, rows, status stamps, posters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Select tiles, never-tiles, caption boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The either-or choice frame.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-tape
tokens.usage: Under tape labels and the tonight bar: a stuck-on edge.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: Posters pinned to the wall.

tokens.name: shadow-poster
tokens.usage: The poster in focus in the deck or review.

tokens.name: tap-button
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a button.

tokens.name: tap-chip
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a chip or small control.

tokens.name: tap-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom nav item height.

tokens.name: app-max-width
tokens.usage: The app is one phone-width column.

tokens.name: tilt-tape
tokens.usage: Tape labels and the home poster.

tokens.name: tilt-bar
tokens.usage: The tonight bar.

tokens.name: tilt-stamp
tokens.usage: YES stamp (NOPE uses +10deg).
